verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents several first-party programmatic surfaces for tenant management. The official MCP server can create apps, deploy Actions, debug logs and manage users "all without touching the dashboard." The Auth0 CLI manages tenant configuration and automates tasks, and a Terraform module sets up apps, APIs, roles, MFA, enterprise SSO and custom domains. None of this evidence states that the API covers everything the dashboard can do, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 at every candidate path, so parity is implied rather than proven. Missing for 10: an explicit statement of Management API/UI parity, a published OpenAPI spec, coverage evidence for dashboard-only areas such as log-stream payload preview, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
